name: harnessmux
description: Control DeepSeek Harness from Codex: a durable mailbox with MCP tools, so work can be handed to an existing harness session and results come back on the same thread.

interface.shortDescription: Hand work to DeepSeek Harness from Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect this Codex session to DeepSeek Harness through HarnessMux. Messages are delivered durably to a harness session that is already open, results come back on the same thread, and the mailbox keeps a message when nothing is running instead of dropping it. Use HarnessMux when work belongs in the harness, when the harness is waiting on your result, or when the user says another agent sent instructions.
defaultPrompt: Check HarnessMux for messages from the harness
Hand this task to DeepSeek Harness and report back
Ask the harness what it found
